common.title: Their Share
common.text: They can see what you gain. They can’t yet see what they do.

common.title: Too Good to Be True
common.text: It sounds too good, and in their experience it usually is.

common.title: Loose Terms
common.text: Your words are doing more work than your meaning.

common.title: A Contradiction
common.text: Two of your best points can’t both be true.

common.title: Silence
common.text: Nothing comes back across the table. The quiet is doing the work.

common.title: The Point
common.text: They have stopped listening to the preamble.

crux.title: Not Yet Proven
crux.text: They don’t doubt you believe it. They doubt it would survive another hour of questions.

cards.title: Method
cards.text: The result may stand. How you reached it may not.

cards.title: Sources
cards.text: Every claim needs a page and a name behind it.

cards.title: The Weak Chapter
cards.text: They have found the part of your work you hoped they would skip.

cards.title: The Obvious Objection
cards.text: There is an objection anyone would raise, and you have not answered it.

cards.title: A Small Point
cards.text: A minor objection that turns out not to be minor.

cards.title: The Silent Examiner
cards.text: One of them has said nothing, and is writing everything down.

cards.title: Show It Working
cards.text: Theory will not do. They want to see it.

cards.title: Under the Lamp
cards.text: The room is warm, the questions are slow, and your voice is going.

cards.title: A Generous Reading
cards.text: Someone on the panel wants to be on your side, if you give them the words.

cards.title: First Principles
cards.text: They take it all the way back to the beginning, and wait.

cards.title: The Hourglass
cards.text: The sand is running and the work is not finished.

cards.title: Credentials
cards.text: Only someone who truly knows the field gets a hearing.

demands.title: Show Me the Spell
demands.text: They will believe it when they see it cast.

crux.title: The Rule Stands
crux.text: The rules don’t bend. You need a reason they should, this once.

cards.title: Procedure
cards.text: There is a proper way to ask for this, and you have not followed it.

cards.title: No Exceptions
cards.text: Bend the rule once, and everyone will want it bent.

cards.title: Your Record
cards.text: It is all in a file, and the file is not kind.

cards.title: The Letter of It
cards.text: What is written says otherwise, and they mean to follow what is written.

cards.title: A Quiet Word
cards.text: If it can be settled without anyone writing it down, they are listening.

cards.title: Precedent
cards.text: Grant it once and it will be quoted back at them for years.

cards.title: Deference
cards.text: They expect to be addressed properly, and first.

cards.title: The Ledger
cards.text: The numbers say what they say, and they are written in ink.

cards.title: Above Their Head
cards.text: Somebody higher up will read this, and they know it.

cards.title: Office Hours
cards.text: Others are waiting, and the clock on the wall is loud.

cards.title: Clean Hands
cards.text: They need to be able to say they did it properly.

demands.title: A Fee
demands.text: There is a fee for this, and it is not waived.

demands.title: Who Are You?
demands.text: They only deal with people whose names they know.

crux.title: Their Price
crux.text: Nothing leaves this table for less than it is worth to them.

cards.title: The Opening Price
cards.text: The first figure is a joke, and you are meant to laugh.

cards.title: Other Buyers
cards.text: Someone else is interested, or so they say.

cards.title: The Going Rate
cards.text: Your figure does not match what these things are worth.

cards.title: Worth Their While
cards.text: It has to be worth their while.

cards.title: The Walk Away
cards.text: You could leave. They need to believe you will.

cards.title: Quality
cards.text: They turn it slowly in the light to show you it is the real thing.

cards.title: A Sweetener
cards.text: A little extra on the side would smooth things.

cards.title: An Old Debt
cards.text: Something is still owed from last time.

cards.title: The Scales
cards.text: Their weights are not quite honest, and they know you know.

cards.title: Back and Forth
cards.text: Every number you name is somewhere for them to start.

cards.title: In Writing
cards.text: Get it written down, or it never happened.

demands.title: Cash on the Table
demands.text: Nothing moves until something changes hands.

demands.title: A Reference
demands.text: They deal with people of some reputation.

crux.title: What It Means
crux.text: This is not about winning. They need to know you mean it.

cards.title: The Hurt
cards.text: Whatever you say, they will hear the thing you did first.

cards.title: History
cards.text: Everything that has passed between you is in the room.

cards.title: The Promise
cards.text: You promised once. They remember the words exactly.

cards.title: A Joke Too Many
cards.text: You reach for a joke, and they see you reach.

cards.title: Someone Else
cards.text: There is someone else in this, even if they are not here.

cards.title: The Quiet
cards.text: Neither of you speaks for a long time.

cards.title: A Small Kindness
cards.text: Tea, a blanket, a hand on the shoulder.

cards.title: What You Said
cards.text: Something you said months ago, given back word for word.

cards.title: All of It
cards.text: They want the whole truth, including the part you left out.

cards.title: Family
cards.text: Their family is in this too, and has opinions.

cards.title: The Door
cards.text: They keep glancing at the door.

cards.title: A Real Promise
cards.text: Words will not do. They need to see what you are to each other.

demands.title: Help, Not Words
demands.text: What they need is practical, and it costs.

crux.title: The Room
crux.text: The room has made up its mind about you. Change it.

cards.title: The Laugh
cards.text: The room is laughing, and it is laughing at you.

cards.title: A Heckler
cards.text: Something from the back of the room pulls every eye away.

cards.title: A Toast
cards.text: Glasses are raised, and everyone waits for you to say something.

cards.title: A Rumour
cards.text: Someone is passing something along, behind a hand.

cards.title: The Rival
cards.text: Someone else here wants the room more than you do.

cards.title: Manners
cards.text: Which fork, which title, which order. Everyone is watching.

cards.title: Masks
cards.text: Nobody here is quite who they seem.

cards.title: Your Story
cards.text: They want it told well, with an ending.

cards.title: Your Name
cards.text: They have heard of you, and not only good things.

cards.title: The Hush
cards.text: The whole room goes quiet to hear what you say next.

cards.title: The Crowd Turns
cards.text: Half the room is with you now. Half is not.

demands.title: Who Are You?
demands.text: This room only listens to names it knows.

demands.title: A Round for the Room
demands.text: Nothing warms a room like being paid for.

crux.title: The Story
crux.text: It will be printed one way or another. Make it the true one.

cards.title: The Deadline
cards.text: The presses run at dawn, with you or without you.

cards.title: Red Ink
cards.text: A whole paragraph, struck through without a word.

cards.title: On the Record
cards.text: Every word you say is being written down.

cards.title: A Quote
cards.text: They need one good line, and they need it from you.

cards.title: No Comment
cards.text: Someone is denying everything, including the obvious.

cards.title: The Facts
cards.text: Names, dates, and the order things happened in.

cards.title: The Angle
cards.text: There is a better story here than the true one, and they can smell it.

cards.title: A Source
cards.text: Someone told them in confidence. Whose side are you on?

cards.title: The Headline
cards.text: Six words in large type, and they decide everything.

cards.title: Spelled Right
cards.text: Your name, at least, should be spelled correctly.

cards.title: The Column
cards.text: There is space for only so many words, and yours are too many.

cards.title: Know Your Subject
cards.text: They will not print it unless you know what you are talking about.

demands.title: A Byline
demands.text: Readers trust a name they have seen before.

crux.title: The Old Courtesy
crux.text: It does not care what you want. It cares whether you have been proper about it.

cards.title: A Riddle
cards.text: A question with an answer, and the answer is not the obvious one.

cards.title: The Wrong Answer
cards.text: It has heard every clever answer. It wants the right one.

cards.title: Courtesy
cards.text: You have not yet bowed, and it has noticed.

cards.title: A Trick
cards.text: It offers you something, and it is clearly a trick.

cards.title: Old Names
cards.text: It wants to be called by its proper name.

cards.title: A Gift
cards.text: Something given freely, or not at all.

cards.title: Stillness
cards.text: It moves toward you, and you must not step back.

cards.title: The Bargain
cards.text: Every word of the bargain matters, and some of them are hiding.

cards.title: Spellwork
cards.text: The air is thick with something old. It wants to see what you can do with it.

cards.title: A Change of Mood
cards.text: Its temper turns like weather.

cards.title: In Circles
cards.text: It has led you in a circle, to see if you notice.

demands.title: Show Me Your Magic
demands.text: It will listen to a spell before it listens to words.

demands.title: A Drop of Blood
demands.text: What it wants of you will hurt to give.

crux.title: The Grip
crux.text: They hold something, or someone. Words are all you have to loosen it.

cards.title: The Threat
cards.text: Nothing is said outright. Nothing needs to be.

cards.title: Cold
cards.text: Frost creeps along every edge, and your breath is short.

cards.title: Leverage
cards.text: They know something about you, and want you to know they know.

cards.title: A Lie
cards.text: Something they said is false, and it is the part that matters.

cards.title: Old Family
cards.text: Old names, old debts, and an old way of settling them.

cards.title: The Offer
cards.text: They offer you something you want. That is the danger.

cards.title: Under a Spell
cards.text: Someone here is not speaking for themselves.

cards.title: Doubt
cards.text: What if they are right?

cards.title: Nerve
cards.text: They step closer, and keep stepping.

cards.title: A Crack
cards.text: Their certainty slips for a moment. Only a moment.

cards.title: No Witnesses
cards.text: Nobody else is here, and nobody else would believe you.

cards.title: Prove Your Power
cards.text: They respect only what they can see you do.

demands.title: A Price in Blood
demands.text: Some debts are not paid in coin.

compel.title: Compulsion
compel.text: His voice is very reasonable. You find yourself agreeing with it.
compel.lands: You agree to everything, in a voice not your own. The meeting is lost.

bewitch.title: Bewitched
bewitch.text: Something sweet in the air makes your best points sound foolish.
bewitch.lands: Your best points sound foolish now: −3 Agreement.

hush.title: A Hush
hush.text: A quiet settles on your hands, the kind that smothers spells.
hush.lands: Your magic is smothered: no more spells this meeting.

lightfingers.title: Light Fingers
lightfingers.text: A charm on the purse strings, while you’re busy talking.
lightfingers.lands: Your purse is lighter, and so is your Mana.
